Use case: compositing. Asset type: full garment on its real wooden hanger, transparent PNG for the Coatshal store.
Input 1 is the coat to preserve: exact black fabric, tailoring, gold lapel pin, dark buttons, lining, full sleeves, entire bottom hem.
Input 2 is the REQUIRED hanger reference, a real close photo from this shop. Recreate that SAME broad curved dark walnut hanger with a thick rectangular curved central wooden block, small gold Coatshal branding "كوتشال" above "COATSHAL", thick flat brass J-hook, and shoulders naturally INSIDE the jacket. The wooden center block is visible inside/above the collar. The hanger MUST physically support the garment from inside its shoulders as in input 2, not sit floating above it. No thin wire hanger, no triangular illustrated hanger, no long thin stem or string between jacket and hanger.
Photorealistic isolated full front view of ONE coat, on ONE realistic shop hanger, with a subtle natural drape. Camera almost directly from front, no strong perspective. Whole subject centered in a square transparent canvas: top of brass hook at 3% of canvas height; broad branded wood around 12-19%; coat collar starts around 17%; coat ends around 95%; coat width about 68%. Hook top centered at x=50%. Render no rack/bar at all, since the website supplies the rail.
Keep the jacket complete and color-faithful. Realistic wood grain, brushed brass and textile. Actual transparent alpha everywhere outside hook, hanger and coat, including gaps. No backdrop, no ground, no shadows on the background, no extra garments, no collage or labels.
